ClientResponses.Response:
Your feedback is very important to us. We are very sorry to hear you are having an issue with your grill not going above 350 degrees. We are here to help. 

It sounds like you may be activating a safety device built into the regulator. This safety device is a component of all LP gas regulators and is designed to reduce the flow of gas in the event of a leak.

You can inadvertently activate the safety device without having a gas leak. Typically, this occurs if you do not wait a sufficient time between opening the tank valve and the burner control knobs or if one or more of the burner control knobs is in an open position when opening the LP tank valve. When the safety device has been activated the grill is referred to as being in “bypass”.

Keep in mind that the safety device reacts to gas leaks. If a grill is in bypass, the gas connections and hose should be tested for leaks with a soap and water solution.

If you do activate the gas regulator safety device, the grill may struggle to reach high temperatures or may not light at all, even with all burners on the START/HIGH setting.

To ensure that you are not inadvertently activating the safety device as you turn on the grill, please use the following procedure:
Turn all burner control knobs to OFF, including the side burner control knob if present.
Visually confirm all burners are extinguished (no flame present) 
Make sure the grill lid is open. Open the LP tank valve and then wait at least 60 seconds. This will allow the hose and regulator to pressurize.
Turn the appropriate burner control knob for your model grill to the START/HIGH position and then ignite the grill by pushing the ignition button.
Turn each of the other burner control knobs to high, one at a time, and press the igniter button (if applicable for your model). Repeat this process until all the burners have been lit.
Close the grill lid.
The grill should reach approximately 500 to 550 degrees in 10-15 minutes.
When you are done grilling:
Turn all burner control knobs to the OFF position
Turn off the LP tank valve last.

Please look for a follow up email from us soon. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText: I bought a gas grill because charcoal grilling wasn't working out for me. I LOVE this Weber Gas Grill. It's the perfect size for me and my family. I can use it after a long day of work, because it heats up quickly, unlike a charcoal grill that takes a long time to get the charcoal hot (and then, dies out before my food is cooked all the way). AND, if at some point it the flames get too high, I can just turn the gas off and get a handle on it, then turn the gas back on (and NOT burn down my house). Did I mention that I'm new to grilling? Maybe the uncontrolled flames aren't an issue to seasoned grillers, but I'm still learning... The flavor of the food on this grill is awesome! Even my picky Autistic son prefers the burgers I'm grilling on my Weber Gas Grill over getting a pizza (his favorite food). I highly recommend getting a Weber. It's a high quality grill that will last much longer than getting a cheaper choice.
Results.Title: How a Weber Gas Grill is working out for me...

There are several reasons why, but the most important are; 1) Their quality is very good. 2) The heat is always even, which makes it easy for grilling or baking just about anything and; 3) Parts are always readily available, no matter what the model. 

I previously owned a Genesis series, three burner grill, but decided to try the Spirit E-310 this time, as I don't do as much grilling as in the past. I can honestly say, that I have been extremely pleased with the performance of this product, so far!

Your feedback means a lot to us. We are so sorry to hear about your experience.  Regular cleaning and maintenance, as outlined in your owner's guide, is crucially important for maintaining the quality of our grills. Even under regular weather conditions, rust will still occur due to natural causes. We provide care instructions along with every owner's manual to help empower our grill owners.​

We recommend treating exterior grill corrosion as soon as it appears with a cleaner/inhibitor Bar Keeper’s Friend and then cleaning with our stainless steel polish. Maintenance is very important to keep your grill in its best condition.​

Please see the link below for helpful tips.
https://consumer-care.weber.com/hc/en-us/articles/360023839551-How-do-I-clean-the-outside-of-my-grill-

Hopefully, this is helpful. If you need anything further please reach out to us directly. Thank you!

Place serving trays and spices on the side tables so that everything you need is where you are, when you need it. With features such as porcelain-enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.
